title: Part 1 - Training Video for Bell Labs' Holmdel Computing Center - AT&T Archives
summary: A 1973 AT&T training film made for new employees at Bell Labs' Holmdel Computing Center, when Unix was in its third version and running at 16 computer centers in the Bell System. It shows how users submitted jobs and used the center's machines.
why: HN commenters share it as a rare, atmospheric look at what working at an early computing center was actually like, including how code was submitted and processed.

quote.text: This is one of my favorites, about people submitting their code to get processed at their computing center
